title.zh: 第十一 天文中 明十二 章五 和三十三 殤一 安四十六 順二十三 質三
title.raw: 第十一 天文中 明十二 章五 和三十三 殤一 安四十六 順二十三 質三 Volume 101: Astronomy Part Two

sentences.zh: 明十二 章五 和三十三 殤一 安四十六 順二十三 質三〉

translations.literal: The section tallies: twelve entries for Emperor Ming the Filial and Enlightened, five for Emperor Zhang, thirty-three for Emperor He, one for Emperor Shang the Filial Martyr, forty-six for Emperor An, twenty-three for Emperor Shun, and three for Emperor Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: This chapter records twelve celestial portents under Emperor Ming, five under Zhang, thirty-three under He, one under Emperor Shang, forty-six under An, twenty-three under Shun, and three under Zhi.

sentences.zh: 明十二

translations.literal: Ming: twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming the Filial and Enlightened: twelve entries.

sentences.zh: 孝明永平元年四月丁酉，流星大如斗，起天市樓，西南行，光照地。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongping of Emperor Ming the Filial and Enlightened, in the fourth month, on the day dingyou, a meteor as large as the Northern Dipper appeared, rising from the Celestial Market parapet and traveling southwest; its light illuminated the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the fourth month of the first Yongping year (58 CE) of Emperor Ming, a meteor the size of the Dipper rose at the Celestial Market tower and streaked southwest, lighting the earth.

sentences.zh: 流星爲外兵，西南行爲西南夷。

translations.literal: A meteor means troops from without; traveling southwest means the southwestern barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor betokens armies from outside the heartland; motion toward the southwest betokens unrest among the southwestern tribes.

sentences.zh: 是時，益州發兵擊姑復蛮夷大牟替滅陵，斬首傳詣雒陽。

translations.literal: At this time Yizhou sent troops to strike the Gufu Man tribes at Dà Móu, Tì, and Miè Líng; their heads were cut off and sent to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou then mobilized forces against the Gufu Man at Dà Móu, Tì, and Miè Líng; the severed heads were forwarded to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 三年六月丁卯，彗星出天舩北，長二尺所，稍北行至亢南。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the sixth month, on the day dingmao, a comet appeared north of the Celestial Boat asterism, about two feet long, gradually traveling north until south of Kang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the sixth month of the third Yongping year, a comet emerged north of Celestial Boat, roughly two feet in length, and drifted north until it stood south of Kang.

sentences.zh: 百三十五日去。

translations.literal: It departed after one hundred thirty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thirty-five days later it was gone.

sentences.zh: 天舩爲水，彗出之爲大水。

translations.literal: The Celestial Boat stands for water; a comet issuing from it means great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Boat governs the element of water; a comet rising from it presages catastrophic flooding.

sentences.zh: 是歲伊、雒水溢，到津城門，壞伊橋；

translations.literal: That year the Yi and Luo rivers overflowed, reaching the Jin City Gate and destroying the bridge over the Yi.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Yi and Luo burst their banks as far as the Jin City gate and washed out the bridge over the Yi.

sentences.zh: 郡七、縣三十二皆大水。

translations.literal: Seven commanderies and thirty-two counties all suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Seven commanderies and thirty-two counties were inundated.

sentences.zh: 四年八月辛酉，客星出梗河西北，指貫索，七十日去。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in the eighth month, on the day xinyou, a guest star appeared northwest of Genghe, pointing toward Guansuo; after seventy days it departed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the eighth month of the fourth Yongping year, a guest star shone northwest of Genghe, its train aimed at the Coiled Bonds (Guansuo), and it vanished after seventy days.

sentences.zh: 梗河爲胡兵。

translations.literal: Genghe means Hu troops.
translations.idiomatic: Genghe presages steppe (Hu) armies.

sentences.zh: 至五年十一月，北匈奴七千騎入五原塞，十二月又入雲中，至原陽。

translations.literal: By the eleventh month of the fifth year, seven thousand riders of the Northern Xiongnu entered the Wuyuan frontier defences; in the twelfth month they again entered Yunzhong as far as Yuanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year seven thousand Northern Xiongnu horsemen broke through Wuyuan; the next month they raided Yunzhong as far as Yuanyang.

sentences.zh: 貫索，貴人之牢。

translations.literal: Guansuo is the prison of noblemen.
translations.idiomatic: The Coiled Bonds are read as fetters binding high ministers.

sentences.zh: 其十二月，陵鄉侯梁松坐怨望，縣飛書誹謗朝廷，下獄死，妻子家屬徙九真。

translations.literal: In that twelfth month Marquis of Lingxiang Liang Song, for harboring resentment and posting flying letters that slandered the court, died in prison; his wife, children, and dependents were banished to Jiuzhen.
translations.idiomatic: That December Liang Song, marquis of Lingxiang, was charged with resentment and circulating anonymous libels against the court; he died in custody, and his family was exiled to Jiuzhen.

sentences.zh: 七年正月戊子，流星大如杯，從織女西行，光照地。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, in the first month, on the day wuzi, a meteor as large as a cup traveled west from the Weaving Maid; its light illuminated the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the first month of the seventh Yongping year, a cup-sized meteor streaked west from the Weaving Maid (Vega) and lit the landscape.

sentences.zh: 織女，天之真女，流星出之，女主憂。

translations.literal: The Weaving Maid is the true woman of Heaven; a meteor emerging from her means the chief woman will sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: Vega is Heaven’s paradigmatic woman; a meteor from that quarter portends grief for the empress.

sentences.zh: 其月癸卯，光烈皇后崩。

translations.literal: In that month, on the day guimao, Empress Guanglie passed away.
translations.idiomatic: Later that month, on guimao, Empress Guanglie died.

sentences.zh: 八年六月壬午，長星出柳、張三十七度，犯軒轅，刺天舩，陵太微，氣至上階，凡見五十六日去。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year, on the day renwu, a long comet emerged between Willow (Liu) and Extended Net (Zhang), spanning thirty-seven degrees; it offended the Chariot Shaft (Xuanyuan), pierced the Celestial Boat, crossed the Grand Tenuity, and its aura reached the upper steps of the Ecliptic Palace; in all it was visible fifty-six days, then departed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the sixth month of Yongping 8, a long-tailed comet appeared between Willow and Extended Net across thirty-seven degrees, grazed the Chariot Shaft, crossed Celestial Boat, veered through the Grand Tenuity, and its coma stretched toward the upper terrace of the Supreme Palace enclosure; it remained visible fifty-six days.

sentences.zh: 柳，周地。

translations.literal: Willow is the territory of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Willow marks the Zhou heartland.

sentences.zh: 是歲，多雨水，郡十四傷稼。

translations.literal: That year there was much rain; fourteen commanderies suffered damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains that year laid waste to crops in fourteen commanderies.

sentences.zh: 九年正月戊申，客星出牽牛，長八尺，歷建星至房南滅，見至五十日。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, on the day wushen, a guest star emerged from the Herdboy asterism, eight feet long, passing through the Establishment stars to south of Room (Fang), where it was extinguished; from appearance to extinction fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the first month of Yongping 9, a guest star rose at Herdboy, an eight-foot train crossing Establishment to the south of Room, where it died out after fifty days.

sentences.zh: 牽牛主吳、越，房、心爲宋。

translations.literal: Herdboy governs Wu and Yue; Room and Heart are Song.
translations.idiomatic: Herdboy stands for Wu and Yue; Room and Heart for the old Song region.

sentences.zh: 後廣陵王荆與沈凉、楚王英與顏忠各謀逆，事覺，皆自殺。

translations.literal: Later Prince Liu Jing of Guangling with Shen Liang, and Prince Liu Ying of Chu with Yan Zhong, each plotted rebellion; when the affair was exposed, all killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Later Prince Jing of Guangling and Shen Liang, and Prince Ying of Chu and Yan Zhong, were each caught in separate plots of treason and took their own lives when discovered.

sentences.zh: 廣陵屬吳，彭城古宋地。

translations.literal: Guangling belongs to Wu; Pengcheng is old Song territory.
translations.idiomatic: Guangling lay in the Wu sphere, Pengcheng in ancestral Song.

sentences.zh: 十三年閏月丁亥，火犯輿鬼，爲大喪，質星爲大臣誅戮。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, in the intercalary month, on the day dinghai: Mars offended the Ghost asterism, meaning great mourning; the “substance” stars mean senior ministers will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the intercalary month of Yongping 13, Mars trespassed on Ghosts—an omen of deep bereavement—and the attendant stars foretold executions among great ministers.

sentences.zh: 其十二月，楚王英與顏忠等造作妖書謀反，事覺，英自殺，忠等皆伏誅。

translations.literal: In that twelfth month Prince Ying of Chu with Yan Zhong and others forged occult writings to plot rebellion; when it was exposed, Ying killed himself and Zhong and the rest were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Ying of Chu and Yan Zhong were found forging sorcerous texts in a rebellion; Ying committed suicide, and Zhong’s party was put to death.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月戊子，客星出昴，六十日，在軒轅右角稍滅。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year, on the day wuzi, a guest star emerged at Mao (Hairy Head), sixty days, slightly fading at the right horn of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the first month of Yongping 14, a guest star appeared at the Hairy Head (Pleiades), lingered sixty days, and waned beside the right horn of the Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 昴主邊兵。

translations.literal: Mao governs frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Hairy Head governs frontier warfare.

sentences.zh: 後一年，漢遣奉車都尉顯親侯竇固、駙馬都尉耿秉、騎都尉耿忠、開陽城門候秦彭、太仆祭肜，將兵擊匈奴。

translations.literal: After one year Han sent Commandant of Chariots Marquis of Xianqin Dou Gu, Commandant of Horse for the imperial son-in-law Geng Bing, Commandant of Horse Geng Zhong, Gatekeeper of the Kaiyang City Gate Qin Peng, and Grand Coachman Cai Rong leading troops to strike the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the court dispatched Dou Gu (Commandant of Chariots, marquis of Xianqin), Geng Bing (Commandant of Horse, imperial connection), Geng Zhong, Qin Peng (warden of the Kaiyang gate), and Grand Coachman Cai Rong to campaign against the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 一曰，軒轅右角爲貴相，昴爲獄事，客星守之爲大獄。

translations.literal: One opinion: the right horn of the Chariot Shaft is the eminent minister; Mao is prison affairs; a guest star guarding it means great imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: Another reading takes the Chariot Shaft’s right horn as the chief minister, the Hairy Head as judicial punishment, and a stationary guest star there as sweeping imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 是時，考楚事未訖，司徒虞延與楚王英黨與黄初、公孙弘等交通，皆自殺。

translations.literal: At that time the Chu case was not yet finished; Minister of Education Yu Yan communicated with Prince Ying of Chu’s associates Huang Chu, Gongsun Hong, and others; all killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: While the Chu affair was still under investigation, Minister Yu Yan was found colluding with Ying’s clique, including Huang Chu and Gongsun Hong, and all took their own lives.

sentences.zh: 或下獄伏誅。

translations.literal: Or they were imprisoned and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Others were jailed and executed outright.

sentences.zh: 十五年十一月乙丑，太白入月中，爲大將戮，人主亡，不出三年。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, in the eleventh month, on the day yichou, Venus entered the moon, meaning a great general will be executed, the ruler will perish, within three years at the latest.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the eleventh month of Yongping 15, Venus passed into the Moon—an omen of a slaughtered marshal and the ruler’s demise within three years.

sentences.zh: 後三年，孝明帝崩。

translations.literal: After three years Emperor Ming the Filial and Enlightened died.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月丁丑，歲星犯房右驂，北第一星不見，辛巳乃見。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, in the first month, on the day dingchou: Jupiter offended the right trace-horse of Room; the northern first star was invisible until it reappeared on the day xinsi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the first month of Yongping 16, Jupiter crossed the right trace-horse of Room—the northern first star vanished and only reappeared on xinsi.

sentences.zh: 房右驂爲貴臣，歲星犯之爲見誅。

translations.literal: The right trace-horse of Room is a noble minister; Jupiter offending it means execution will be seen.
translations.idiomatic: The right trace-horse of Room denotes a powerful minister; Jupiter’s trespass foretold his downfall by execution.

sentences.zh: 是后司徒邢穆，坐與阜陵王延交通知逆謀，自殺。

translations.literal: Later Minister of Education Xing Mu, for associating with Prince Yan of Fuling and knowing of treasonous plans, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Afterwards Minister Xing Mu, implicated with Prince Yan of Fuling in a treason plot, committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 四月癸未，太白犯畢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the day guimao, Great White offended Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fourth month, Venus trespassed on Net (Bi).

sentences.zh: 畢爲邊兵。

translations.literal: Bi is frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: Net presages border warfare.

sentences.zh: 后北匈奴寇邊，入雲中，至漁陽。

translations.literal: Later the Northern Xiongnu raided the border, entered Yunzhong, reaching Yuyang.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Xiongnu soon raided the frontier, pushing through Yunzhong to Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 使者高弘發三郡兵追討，无所得。

translations.literal: Messenger Gao Hong raised troops of three commanderies to pursue and attack, obtaining nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Envoy Gao Hong called up three commanderies’ forces in pursuit but caught nothing.

sentences.zh: 太仆祭肜坐不進下獄。

translations.literal: Grand Coachman Cai Rong, for not advancing, was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coachman Cai Rong was imprisoned for failing to press the attack.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月己未，彗星出張，長三尺，转在郎將，南入太微，皆屬張。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, in the sixth month, on the day jiwei: a comet emerged at Zhang, three feet long, moving to the Gentlemen-of-the-Palace, entering south into the Grand Tenuity; all pertained to Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the sixth month of Yongping 18, a three-foot comet rose at Extended Net, swung through the Gentlemen-of-the-Palace into the Grand Tenuity—all within Zhang’s celestial zone.

sentences.zh: 張，周地，爲東都。

translations.literal: Zhang is Zhou territory, being the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Extended Net marks the old Zhou domain, here paired with the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 太微，天子廷。

translations.literal: The Grand Tenuity is the court of the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tenuity enclosure is the emperor’s celestial audience hall.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之爲兵喪。

translations.literal: A comet offending it means troops and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A comet there betokens war and bereavement.

sentences.zh: 其八月壬子，孝明帝崩。

translations.literal: That eighth month, on the day renzi, Emperor Ming the Filial and Enlightened passed away.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi that eighth month Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 二年九月甲寅，流星過紫宫中，長數丈，散爲三，滅。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the ninth month, on the day jiayin: a meteor passed through the Purple Palace, several rods long, scattered into three, and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the ninth month of the second Jianchu year (77 CE), a meteor several zhang long crossed the Purple Palace, split into three fragments, and died out.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，彗星出婁三度，長八九尺，稍入紫宫中，百六日稍滅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuyin: a comet emerged three degrees into Bond (Lou), eight or nine feet long, gradually entering the Purple Palace; after one hundred six days it gradually faded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the twelfth month a comet rose three degrees into Bond, eight or nine feet in train, drifted into the Purple Palace, and weakened away over one hundred six days.

sentences.zh: 流星過，入紫宫，皆大人忌。

translations.literal: A meteor passing, entering the Purple Palace, both are taboos for great men.
translations.idiomatic: Meteors crossing into the Purple Palace are omens dire for those in supreme power.

sentences.zh: 后四年六月癸丑，明德皇后崩。

translations.literal: After four years, in the sixth month, on the day guichou, Empress Mingde passed away.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later, on guichou in the sixth month, Empress Mingde died.

sentences.zh: 元和二年四月丁巳，客星晨出東方，在胃八度，長三尺，歷阁道入紫宫，留四十日滅。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanhe, in the fourth month, on the day dingsi: at dawn a guest star appeared in the east, eight degrees into Stomach, three feet long, passing through the Gallery Road into the Purple Palace, lingering forty days then extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on dingsi in the fourth month of Yuanhe 2 (85 CE), a guest star rose eastward in Stomach, traced the Gallery Road into the Purple Palace, and burned out after forty days.

sentences.zh: 阁道、紫宫，天子之宫也。

translations.literal: The Gallery Road and Purple Palace are the palaces of the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Gallery Road and Purple Palace map the emperor’s inner precinct.

sentences.zh: 客星犯入留久爲大喪。

translations.literal: A guest star offending, entering, and lingering long means great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A long-lived intruder there presages a major bereavement.

sentences.zh: 后四年，孝章帝崩。

translations.literal: After four years Emperor Zhang the Filial and Enlightened died.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later Emperor Zhang died.

sentences.zh: 和三十三

translations.literal: He: thirty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor He: thirty-three entries.

sentences.zh: 孝和永元元年正月辛卯，有流星起参，長四丈，有光，色黄白。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan of Emperor He the Filial and Harmonious, in the first month, on the day xinmao: a meteor rose at Shen, four rods long, with light, yellow-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the first month of Yongyuan 1 (89 CE), a yellow-white meteor sprang from Orion (Shen), four zhang long.

sentences.zh: 二月，流星起天棓，東北行三丈所，滅，色青白。

translations.literal: In the second month: a meteor rose from the Celestial Cudgel, traveling northeast about three rods and extinguishing, color green-white.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month another meteor rose at the Celestial Cudgel, streaked about three zhang northeast in pale blue-white fire, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 壬申夜，有流星起太微東蕃，長三丈。

translations.literal: Night of renshen: a meteor rose from the eastern fence of the Grand Tenuity, three rods long.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renshen, a three-zhang meteor shot up from the eastern wall of the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，流星起天津。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingchen: a meteor rose from the Celestial Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the third month a meteor appeared at the Celestial Ford.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，有流星起天將軍，東北行。

translations.literal: On renxu, a meteor rose from the Celestial Great General, traveling northeast.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu a meteor streaked northeast from the Great General asterism.

sentences.zh: 参爲邊兵，天棓爲兵，太微天廷，天津爲水，天將軍爲兵，流星起之皆爲兵。

translations.literal: Shen is frontier troops; the Celestial Cudgel is troops; the Grand Tenuity is Heaven’s court; the Celestial Ford is water; the Celestial Great General is troops; meteors rising from them all are troops.
translations.idiomatic: Orion means border war, the Cudgel means mobilization, the Grand Tenuity is the celestial court, the Ford floods, and the Great General means arms—meteors from any of these all augur war.

sentences.zh: 其六月，漢遣車騎將軍竇憲、执金吾耿秉與度遼將軍鄧鸿出朔方，并進兵临私渠北鞮海，斬虏首万余级，獲生口牛、馬、羊百万头。

translations.literal: That sixth month Han sent chariots-and-cavalry general Dou Xian, Bearer of the Golden Mace Geng Bing with trans-Liao general Deng Hong out of Shuofang, jointly advancing to the north of the private canal and north of the Di Sea, beheading over ten thousand enemies and capturing cattle, horses, and sheep in the hundreds of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the court sent Dou Xian as chariot-and-cavalry general, Geng Bing with the golden mace, and Deng Hong as trans-Liao general from Shuofang; they united their columns at the line of the private canal and the northern Di Sea, took over ten thousand heads, and seized cattle, sheep, and horses by the hundred-thousand.

sentences.zh: 日逐王等八十一部降，凡三十余万人。

translations.literal: The Zhizhu (Day-and-Hunt) king and eighty-one tribes submitted, in all more than three hundred thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhizhu king and eighty-one tribes—over three hundred thousand people in all—surrendered.

sentences.zh: 追单于至西海。

translations.literal: They pursued the Shanyu to the Western Sea.
translations.idiomatic: The pursuit drove the Shanyu as far as the western sea.

sentences.zh: 是歲七月，又雨水漂人民，是其應。

translations.literal: That year in the seventh month again rain and water floated the people; this was its correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month floods again swept people away—the earthly echo of those portents.

sentences.zh: 二年正月乙卯，金、木俱在奎；

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongyuan, in the first month, on the day yimao: metal and wood both were in Kui (Legs).
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the first month of Yongyuan 2, Venus and Jupiter shared Legs (Kui).

sentences.zh: 丙寅，水又在奎。

translations.literal: On bingyin, water again was in Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Mercury too entered Legs.

sentences.zh: 奎主武庫兵，三星會又爲兵喪。

translations.literal: Kui governs the arsenal and weapons; three stars meeting again means troops and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Legs oversees the arsenals; a threefold conjunction there augurs campaigns and losses.

sentences.zh: 辛未，水、金、木在婁，亦爲兵，又爲匿謀。

translations.literal: On xinwei, water, metal, and wood in Lou, again troops, again hidden plotting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Mercury, Venus, and Jupiter crowded Bond (Lou)—another sign of arms and clandestine intrigue.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，有流星大如桃，起紫宫東蕃，西北行五丈稍滅。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingyou: there was a meteor as large as a peach, rising from the eastern fence of the Purple Palace, traveling northwest five rods then going out.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the second month a peach-sized meteor lifted from the east wall of the Purple Palace, arced five zhang northwest, and expired.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，有流星大如瓜，起文昌東北，西南行至少微西滅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the day bingchen: a meteor as large as a gourd rose northeast from Wenchang, traveling southwest to extinguish south of Shaowei.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the fourth month a melon-sized meteor rose northeast of Wenchang, swung southwest, and died out short of Lesser Guard (Shaowei).

sentences.zh: 有頃，音如雷聲，已而金在軒轅大星東北二尺所。

translations.literal: After a while a sound like thunder; thereafter metal was two feet northeast of the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder followed, and Venus soon sat two feet northeast of Regulus.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，有流星如雞子，起太微西，東南行四丈所滅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingwei: a meteor like a chicken egg rose west of the Grand Tenuity, southeast four rods then extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eighth month an egg-sized meteor rose west of the Grand Tenuity, crossed four zhang southeast, and went out.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，有流星大如桃，起天津，西行六丈所消。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the day guiwei: a meteor large as a peach rose from the Celestial Ford, westward six rods then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the tenth month a peach-sized meteor left the Ford and sailed six zhang west before fading.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有流星大如拳，起紫宫，西行到胃消。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinyou: a meteor large as a fist rose from the Purple Palace, west to Stomach then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the eleventh month a fist-sized meteor crossed from the Purple Palace westward into Stomach and disappeared.

sentences.zh: 三年九月丁卯，有流星大如雞子，起紫宫，西南至北斗柄间消。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the ninth month, on the day dingmao: a meteor large as an egg rose from the Purple Palace, southwest to the gap of the Northern Dipper handle then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the ninth month of Yongyuan 3 an egg-sized meteor ran from the Purple Palace southwest between the Dipper stars and expired.

sentences.zh: 紫宫天子宫，文昌、少微爲貴臣，天津爲水，北斗主殺。

translations.literal: The Purple Palace is the Son of Heaven’s palace; Wenchang and Shaowei are noble ministers; the Celestial Ford is water; the Northern Dipper governs killing.
translations.idiomatic: The Purple Palace is the imperial dwelling; Wenchang and Lesser Guard are great ministers; the Ford is flood; the Dipper, execution.

sentences.zh: 流星起，歷紫宫、文昌、少微、天津，文昌爲天子使，出有兵誅也。

translations.literal: The meteor rising, passing the Purple Palace, Wenchang, Shaowei, Celestial Ford—Wenchang is the Son of Heaven’s envoy; its issuing means there will be troops and executions.
translations.idiomatic: Because Wenchang is the sovereign’s herald, that meteor’s path through the Purple Palace, Wenchang, Lesser Guard, and the Ford spelled mobilization and capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 竇憲爲大將軍，憲弟笃、景等皆卿、校尉，憲女弟婿郭举爲侍中、射聲校尉，與卫尉鄧叠母元俱出入宫中，謀爲不轨。

translations.literal: Dou Xian was great general; Xian’s younger brothers Du and Jing were all ministers and colonels; Xian’s younger sister’s husband Guo Ju was attendant-in-chamber and colonel of the She-sheng guard; with chamberlain Deng Die’s mother Yuan all went in and out of the palace plotting disobedience.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Xian held the supreme command while his brothers Du and Jing filled ministerial and colonel’s posts; his sister’s husband Guo Ju served as palace attendant and colonel of the She-sheng guard; together with chamberlain Deng Die, Die’s mother Lady Yuan, and others they trafficked in and out of the inner palace and plotted usurpation.

sentences.zh: 至四年六月丙辰發覺，和帝幸北宫，詔执金吾、五校勒兵屯南、北宫，閉城門，捕举。

translations.literal: To the fourth year sixth month day bingchen it was discovered; the Harmonious Emperor went to the North Palace; edict Bearer of the Golden Mace and Five Camp troops garrisoned south and north palaces, closed city gates, arrested Ju.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the sixth month of Yongyuan 4 the plot surfaced; the emperor moved to the North Palace and ordered the Bearer of the Golden Mace and the Five Brigades to seal the south and north palace compounds and the city gates and seize Guo Ju.

sentences.zh: 举父長乐少府璜及叠，叠弟步兵校尉磊、母元，皆下獄誅。

translations.literal: Ju’s father grand tutor of Changle Huang and Die, Die’s younger brother colonel of infantry Lei, mother Yuan, all were cast in prison and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ju’s father Huang, grand tutor of Changle, Deng Die, Die’s younger brother Lei (colonel of foot), and Lady Yuan were all thrown in prison and executed.

sentences.zh: 憲弟笃、景等皆自殺。

translations.literal: Xian’s younger brothers Du, Jing, and others all committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Xian’s brothers Du and Jing killed themselves with the rest of the circle.

sentences.zh: 金犯軒轅，女主失勢。

translations.literal: Metal offending the Chariot Shaft, the chief woman loses power.
translations.idiomatic: Venus trespassing Regulus meant the empress would lose her sway.

sentences.zh: 竇氏被誅，太后失勢。

translations.literal: The Dou clan was executed; the empress dowager lost power.
translations.idiomatic: When the Dou were extirpated, the empress dowager was stripped of influence.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月丙午，流星大如瓜，起氐，西南行，稍有光，白色。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, in the fifth month, on the day bingwu: a meteor large as a gourd rose in Di, traveling southwest slightly luminous, white color.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fifth month of Yongyuan 11 a gourd-sized meteor lifted in Base (Di), glided southwest with a pale white glow.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「流星白，爲有使客，大爲大使，小亦小使。

translations.literal: Omens say: “A white meteor means there is an envoy guest; large means great envoy, small also small envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: “A pale meteor signals a diplomatic courier—the larger the star, the weightier the mission.

sentences.zh: 疾期疾，遲亦遲。

translations.literal: Swift term swift, slow also slow.
translations.idiomatic: If it moves swiftly, news comes soon; if slowly, the messenger is delayed.

sentences.zh: 大如瓜爲近，小行稍有光爲遲也。

translations.literal: Large as a gourd means near; small travel slightly luminous means slow.
translations.idiomatic: Gourd size means the envoy is already close; a dimmer, smaller track means a slower arrival.

sentences.zh: 又正王日，邊方有受王命者也。

translations.literal: Further on correct king day, the border region has one who receives the king’s command.
translations.idiomatic: Again, if it falls on the orthodox king day, some frontier chief is accepting an imperial patent.

sentences.zh: 」明年二月，蜀郡旄牛徼外夷白狼樓薄种王唐缯等率种人口十七万归义内屬，賜金印紫绶錢帛。

translations.literal: ” The next second month Shu commandery Mao Niu beyond-the-passes barbarians white wolf Loubo tribe king Tang Zeng and others led tribe people one hundred seventy thousand to submit allegiance internally, were bestowed gold seal purple ribbon cash and silk.
translations.idiomatic: The following second month, chiefs such as Tang Zeng of the white-wolf Loubo tribe beyond Mao Niu in Shu led one hundred seventy thousand people to tender allegiance and received gold seals, purple ribbons, coin, and silk.

sentences.zh: 十二年十一月癸酉夜，有苍白氣，長三丈，起天园，東北指軍市，見积十日。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, in the eleventh month, on the day guiyou night: there was pale white vapor three rods long, rising from the Celestial Garden, northeast pointing at Army Market, seen ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiyou in the eleventh month of Yongyuan 12, an ashen band three zhang long stretched from the Celestial Garden toward Army Market and remained visible ten days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵起，十日期歲。

translations.literal: Omens say: “Troops rise; ten days count as a year.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss says: “War is coming—treat each day of visibility as a year’s warning.

sentences.zh: 」明年十一月，遼東鮮卑二千余騎寇右北平。

translations.literal: ” The next eleventh month Liaodong Xianbei over two thousand riders raided Right Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: The following November more than two thousand Liaodong Xianbei horsemen struck Right Beiping.

sentences.zh: 十三年十一月乙丑，軒轅第四星间有小客星，色青黄。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, in the eleventh month, on the day yichou: between the fourth star of the Chariot Shaft there was a small guest star, color green-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the eleventh month of Yongyuan 13, a small guest star showed green-yellow between the fourth stars of the Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 軒轅爲后宫，星出之，爲失勢。

translations.literal: The Chariot Shaft is the rear palace; a star emerging from it means loss of power.
translations.idiomatic: The Chariot Shaft stands for the harem; a star between its lights foretold a consort’s fall.

sentences.zh: 其十四年六月辛卯，陰皇后廢。

translations.literal: That fourteenth year sixth month day xinmao, Empress Yin was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Yongyuan 14, on xinmao, Empress Yin was cast aside.

sentences.zh: 孝殤帝延平元年正月丁酉，金、火在婁。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanping of Emperor Shang the Filial Martyr, in the first month, on the day dingyou: metal and fire were in Lou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the first month of Yanping 1 (106 CE), Venus and Mars shared Bond (Lou).

sentences.zh: 金、火合爲烁，爲大人憂。

translations.literal: Metal and fire joining is scintillation, great man’s worry.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars fuse into a scorching blaze, those in highest station should tremble.

sentences.zh: 是歲八月辛亥，孝殤帝崩。

translations.literal: That year in the eighth month, on the day xinhai, Emperor Shang the Filial Martyr passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai that year, the child emperor Shang died.

sentences.zh: 安四十六

translations.literal: An: forty-six.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An the Filial and Secure: forty-six entries.

sentences.zh: 二年正月戊子，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the first month, on the day wuzi, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the first month of the second Yongchu year, Venus was visible in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 四年六月甲子，客星大如李，苍白，芒氣長二尺，西南指上階星。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in the sixth month, on the day jiazi: a guest star as large as a plum, pale white, with a rayed aura two feet long, pointed southwest toward the Upper Steps star.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the sixth month of Yongchu 4, a plum-sized guest star shone pale white with a two-foot coma aimed southwest at the Upper Steps.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太白入輿鬼。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Great White entered the Ghosts asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Venus entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 指上階，爲三公。

translations.literal: Pointing at the Upper Steps means the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: A train toward the Upper Steps foretells the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 后太尉張禹、司空張敏皆免官。

translations.literal: Later Grand Commandant Zhang Yu and Minister of Works Zhang Min were both removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Zhang Yu and Minister of Works Zhang Min were soon dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太白入輿鬼，爲將凶。

translations.literal: Great White entering the Ghosts means misfortune for generals.
translations.idiomatic: Venus in the Ghosts bodes ill for field commanders.

sentences.zh: 后中郎將任尚坐赃千万，槛車征，棄市。

translations.literal: Later General of the Gentlemen of the Household Ren Shang, for embezzlement to the tune of ten million cash, was summoned in a caged cart and exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Later Household General Ren Shang was charged with embezzling ten million cash, carted to the capital in a cage, and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 五年六月辛丑，太白昼見，经天。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, in the sixth month, on the day xinchou, Great White was seen by day and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the sixth month of Yongchu 5, Venus blazed by day clear across the meridian.

sentences.zh: 元初元年三月癸酉，熒惑入輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanchu, in the third month, on the day guiyou, Mars entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the third month of Yuanchu 1, Mars entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 二年九月辛酉，熒惑入輿鬼中。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the ninth month, on the day xinyou, Mars entered among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the ninth month of Yuanchu 2, Mars stood deep within the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，熒惑入輿鬼中。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the third month, Mars entered among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuanchu 3 Mars again entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，太白入畢口。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingyin, Great White entered the mouth of Net.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fifth month Venus slipped into the mouth of the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 七月甲寅，歲星入輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day jiayin, Jupiter entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the seventh month Jupiter entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 閏月己未，太白犯太微左执法。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiwei, Great White offended the Left Law Enforcer of the Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the intercalary month Venus trespassed on the Left Law Enforcer in the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，客星見西方，己亥在虚、危，南至胃、昴。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiawu, a guest star appeared in the west; on jihai it was in Emptiness and Rooftop, south to Stomach and Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the eleventh month a guest star rose in the west; by jihai it lay between Emptiness and Rooftop and stretched south toward Stomach and the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 四年正月丙戌，歲星留輿鬼中。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in the first month, on the day bingxu, Jupiter lingered among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the first month of Yuanchu 4 Jupiter halted inside the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太白昼見丙上。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Great White was seen by day above bing.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Venus shone in daylight in the bing sector of the sky; received commentary often glosses that position with the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌，太白入輿鬼中。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the day renxu, Great White entered among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fourth month Venus entered the heart of the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，辰星入輿鬼中。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Morning Star entered among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Mercury entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，辰星犯歲星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jimao, the Morning Star offended Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the fifth month Mercury crossed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，熒惑人輿鬼中，戊戌，犯輿鬼大星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingshen, Mars entered among the Ghosts; on the day wuxu it offended the great star of the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the sixth month Mars entered the Ghosts; two days later, on wuxu, it struck the principal star of the cluster.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，太白人南斗口中。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinsi, Great White entered the mouth of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the ninth month Venus entered the gap of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 五年三月丙申，鎮星犯東井钺星。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, in the third month, on the day bingshen, Saturn offended the battle-axe star of Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the third month of Yuanchu 5 Saturn crossed the axe star in Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，辰星犯輿鬼質星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengwu, the Morning Star offended the “substance” star of the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the fifth month Mercury trespassed on the attendant star of the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白犯钺星。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Great White offended the battle-axe star.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Venus crossed the battle-axe star.

sentences.zh: 六年四月癸丑，太白入輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, in the fourth month, on the day guichou, Great White entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the fourth month of Yuanchu 6 Venus entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，熒惑在輿鬼中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingxu, Mars was among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the sixth month Mars remained inside the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，鎮星在輿鬼中。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Saturn was among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Saturn too sat within the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太白犯左执法。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Great White offended the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Venus encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 自永初五年到永宁，十年之中，太白一昼見经天，再入輿鬼，一守畢，再犯左执法，入南斗，犯钺星。

translations.literal: From the fifth year of Yongchu down to Yongning, in ten years Great White was once seen by day crossing the sky, twice entered the Ghosts, once guarded Net, twice offended the Left Law Enforcer, entered the Southern Dipper, and offended the battle-axe star.
translations.idiomatic: Across the decade from Yongchu 5 to Yongning, Venus showed once in daylight athwart the heavens, twice entered the Ghosts, once stationed on Net, twice brushed the Left Law Enforcer, dipped into the Southern Dipper, and struck the battle-axe star.

sentences.zh: 熒惑五入輿鬼。

translations.literal: Mars five times entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the Ghosts on five separate occasions.

sentences.zh: 鎮星一犯東井钺星，一入輿鬼。

translations.literal: Saturn once offended the battle-axe star of Eastern Well, once entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn once crossed the axe in Eastern Well and once entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 歲星、辰星再入輿鬼。

translations.literal: Jupiter and the Morning Star twice entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter and Mercury each entered the Ghosts twice.

sentences.zh: 凡五星入輿鬼中，皆爲死喪。

translations.literal: Whenever the Five Planets enter among the Ghosts, all mean death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Any of the five wanderers inside the Ghosts presages death and lamentation.

sentences.zh: 熒惑、太白甚犯钺、質星爲誅戮。

translations.literal: Mars and Great White especially offending the battle-axe and “substance” stars mean executions.
translations.idiomatic: Mars and Venus striking the axe or attendant stars especially foretell slaughter.

sentences.zh: 斗爲貴將。

translations.literal: The Dipper means eminent generals.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Dipper governs high commanders.

sentences.zh: 执法爲近臣。

translations.literal: The Law Enforcer means intimate ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Law Enforcer stars stand for palace intimates.

sentences.zh: 客星在虚、危爲喪，爲哭泣。

translations.literal: A guest star in Emptiness and Rooftop means mourning, means weeping.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star over Emptiness and Rooftop signals bereavement and public keening.

sentences.zh: 昂、畢爲邊兵，又爲獄事。

translations.literal: Hairy Head and Net are frontier troops, also prison affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Hairy Head and Net govern border war and the prison system alike.

sentences.zh: 至建光元年三月癸巳，鄧太后崩；

translations.literal: By the first year of Jianguang, in the third month, on the day guisi, Empress Dowager Deng passed away;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Jianguang 1, on guisi, Empress Dowager Deng died;

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，太后兄車騎將軍骘等七侯皆免官，自殺，是其應也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengchen, the empress dowager’s elder brother chariots-and-cavalry general Zhi and seven marquises were all removed from office, killed themselves; this was its correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen, her brother Deng Zhi, chariot-and-cavalry general, and seven ennobled kinsmen were stripped of rank and forced to suicide—the earthly fulfillment of those omens.

sentences.zh: 延光二年八月己亥，熒惑出太微端門。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanguang, in the eighth month, on the day jihai, Mars emerged from the Duan Gate of the Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eighth month of Yanguang 2 Mars issued from the Duan Gate of the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 三年二月辛未，太白犯昂。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the second month, on the day xinwei, Great White offended the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the second month of Yanguang 3 Venus trespassed on the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，太白入畢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guichou, Great White entered Net.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the fifth month Venus entered Net.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，鎮星犯左执法。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renyin, Saturn offended the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the ninth month Saturn crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 四年，太白入輿鬼中。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Great White entered among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanguang 4 Venus entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，太白出太微。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renchen, Great White emerged from the Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the sixth month Venus exited the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，太白入斗口中。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiazi, Great White entered the mouth of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the ninth month Venus entered the Dipper’s gap.

sentences.zh: 十一月，客星見天市。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, a guest star appeared in the Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month a guest star shone in the Celestial Market.

sentences.zh: 熒惑出太微，爲乱臣。

translations.literal: Mars emerging from the Grand Tenuity means rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Mars leaving the Grand Tenuity marks traitorous ministers at court.

sentences.zh: 太白犯昂、畢，爲邊兵，一曰大人当之。

translations.literal: Great White offending the Hairy Head and Net means frontier troops; one opinion says a great man will answer for it.
translations.idiomatic: Venus afflicting the Hairy Head or Net augurs border war, or, in another reading, doom for a man of the highest rank.

sentences.zh: 鎮星犯左执法，有誅臣。

translations.literal: Saturn offending the Left Law Enforcer means there will be a minister executed.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn on the Left Law Enforcer promises the execution of a minister.

sentences.zh: 太白入輿鬼中，爲大喪。

translations.literal: Great White entering among the Ghosts means great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Venus inside the Ghosts signals a great bereavement.

sentences.zh: 太白出太微，爲中宫有兵；

translations.literal: Great White emerging from the Grand Tenuity means there will be troops in the inner palace;
translations.idiomatic: Venus quitting the Grand Tenuity foretells arms within the inner court;

sentences.zh: 入斗口，爲貴將相有誅者。

translations.literal: entering the Dipper’s mouth means eminent generals and ministers will have one executed.
translations.idiomatic: its plunge into the Dipper’s mouth means a leading general or minister will die by the sword.

sentences.zh: 客星見天市中，爲貴喪。

translations.literal: A guest star appearing in the Celestial Market means mourning for the noble.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star in the Celestial Market foretells the death of a great noble.

sentences.zh: 是時，大將軍耿宝、中常侍江京、樊丰、小黄門劉安與阿母王聖、聖子女永等并构谮太子保，并恶太子乳母男、厨监邴吉。

translations.literal: At this time great general Geng Bao, Regular Attendants Jiang Jing and Fan Feng, junior Yellow Gate Liu An together with the heir’s nurse Wang Sheng and Sheng’s son and daughter Yong and others all framed Heir Apparent Bao; they also maligned the heir’s wet nurse Nan and kitchen intendant Bing Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Geng Bao the great general, eunuchs Jiang Jing and Fan Feng, junior Yellow Gate Liu An, the wet nurse Wang Sheng, and her children Yong and others conspired to slander Crown Prince Bao and blackened his nurse Nan and steward Bing Ji.

sentences.zh: 三年九月丁酉，廢太子爲濟陰王，以北鄉侯懿代。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the ninth month, on the day dingyou, the heir apparent was deposed as prince of Jiyin, replaced by Marquis of Beixiang Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the ninth month of Yanguang 3 the crown prince was demoted to prince of Jiyin, and Marquis Yi of Beixiang was set up in his place.

sentences.zh: 殺男、吉，徙其父母妻子日南。

translations.literal: Nan and Ji were killed; their parents, wives, and children were banished to Rinan.
translations.idiomatic: Nan and Bing Ji were put to death, and their families were exiled to Rinan.

sentences.zh: 四年三月丁卯，安帝巡狩，從南陽还，道寝疾，至叶，崩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in the third month, on the day dingmao, the An Emperor went on tour, returning from Nanyang; on the road he took to his bed with illness, reached Ye, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the third month of Yanguang 4 the emperor returned from a progress through Nanyang, fell gravely ill en route, reached Ye, and died there.

sentences.zh: 阎后與兄卫尉顯、中常侍江京等共隐匿，不令群臣知上崩，遣司徒劉喜等分詣郊庙，告天请命，载入北宫。

translations.literal: Empress Yan with her elder brother chamberlain Xian and Regular Attendant Jiang Jing and others together concealed the matter, not letting the host of ministers know the sovereign had died; they sent Minister of Education Liu Xi and others separately to the suburban altars and temples to announce to Heaven and seek fate, then carried him into the North Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Yan, her brother the chamberlain Yan Xian, Jiang Jing, and their faction hid the news of the emperor’s death from the bureaucracy, dispatched Minister Liu Xi to the suburban shrines to perform bogus reports, and smuggled the body into the North Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午夕發喪，尊阎氏爲太后。

translations.literal: Evening of gengwu they issued mourning and honored the Yan clan as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: That evening, on gengwu, they at last proclaimed the obsequies and elevated the Yan family as dowager regents.

sentences.zh: 北鄉侯懿病薨，京等又不欲立保，白太后，更征諸王子择所立。

translations.literal: Marquis of Beixiang Yi died of illness; Jing and the rest again did not wish to install Bao, reported to the empress dowager, and again summoned princes of the blood to choose whom to establish.
translations.idiomatic: When Marquis Yi of Beixiang died of sickness, Jiang Jing’s party still refused to enthrone Bao, petitioned the dowager, and called in other imperial sons to pick a successor.

sentences.zh: 中黄門孙程、王国、王康等十九人，共合謀誅顯、京等，立保爲天子，是爲孝順皇帝。

translations.literal: Yellow Gates Sun Cheng, Wang Guo, Wang Kang, nineteen men in all, jointly plotted to execute Xian, Jing, and others and establish Bao as Son of Heaven; this is Emperor Shun the Filial and Harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteen eunuchs led by Sun Cheng, Wang Guo, and Wang Kang then slew Yan Xian and Jiang Jing, raised Bao to the throne as Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 皆奸人强臣狂乱王室，其于死亡誅戮，兵起宫中，是其應。

translations.literal: All were wicked men and overbearing ministers who crazily threw the royal house into chaos; as to their deaths, executions, and troops rising in the palace, this was its correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: These were treacherous favorites and domineering ministers who convulsed the dynasty; the executions and fighting within the palace were the earthly echo of those celestial signs.

sentences.zh: 順二十三

translations.literal: Shun: twenty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shun the Filial and Harmonious: twenty-three entries.

sentences.zh: 孝順永建二年二月癸未，太白昼見三十九日。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongjian of Emperor Shun the Filial and Harmonious, in the second month, on the day guiwei, Great White was seen by day thirty-nine days.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the second month of Yongjian 2, Venus remained visible in daylight for thirty-nine days.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙酉，太白昼見東南维四十一日。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day yiyou, Great White was seen by day in the southeast corner forty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yiyou, Venus shone by day at the southeast corner of the sky for forty-one days.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，熒惑入輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yisi, Mars entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the eighth month Mars entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 太白昼見，爲强臣。

translations.literal: Great White seen by day means overbearing ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight Venus marks ministers grown too strong for the throne.

sentences.zh: 熒惑爲凶，輿鬼爲死喪。

translations.literal: Mars means ill fortune; the Ghosts mean death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Mars brings calamity; the Ghosts, the grave.

sentences.zh: 質星爲誅戮。

translations.literal: The “substance” star means executions.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant star of the cluster means judicial killing.

sentences.zh: 是時，中常侍高梵、張防、將作大匠翟酺、尚書令高堂芝、仆射張敦、尚書尹就、郎姜述、杨凤等，及兗州刺史鲍就、使匈奴中郎將張国、金城太守張笃、敦煌太守張郎相與交通，漏泄，就、述棄市，梵、防、酺、芝、敦、凤、就、国皆抵罪。

translations.literal: At this time Regular Attendants Gao Fan, Zhang Fang, master of works Zhai Fu, Director of the Secretariat Gao Tang Zhi, vice director Zhang Dun, secretariat directors Yin Jiu, Gentleman of the Palace Jiang Shu, Yang Feng and others, together with Yanzhou inspector Bao Jiu, general of the household to the Xiongnu Zhang Guo, Jinquan governor Zhang Du, Dunhuang governor Zhang Lang, communicated with one another and leaked secrets; Jiu and Shu were exposed in the market, while Fan, Fang, Fu, Zhi, Dun, Feng, Jiu, and Guo all received punishment according to their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: A ring of palace attendants and provincial officials, including Gao Fan, Zhang Fang, Zhai Fu, Gao Tang Zhi, Zhang Dun, Yin Jiu, Jiang Shu, Yang Feng, Inspector Bao Jiu of Yanzhou, Xiongnu household general Zhang Guo, Jinquan’s Zhang Du, and Dunhuang’s Zhang Lang, traded confidential information; Yin Jiu and Jiang Shu were executed in the marketplace, and the rest were sentenced according to their guilt.

sentences.zh: 又定远侯班始尚陰城公主坚得，斗爭殺坚得，坐要斬馬市，同产皆棄市。

translations.literal: Further Marquis Dingyuan Ban Shi had married Princess Jiande of Yincheng Jiande; in a quarrel he killed Jiande, for which he was cut in two at the waist in the horse market, and his full siblings were all exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Ban Shi of Dingyuan, who had wed Princess Jiande of Yincheng, slew her in a domestic brawl and was bisected at the waist in the horse market; his brothers and sisters shared the same fate.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，熒惑入太微中，犯左、右执法西北方六寸所。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, in the fourth month, Mars entered the Grand Tenuity and offended the left and right Law Enforcers about six inches to the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yongjian 6 Mars crossed the Grand Tenuity and brushed both Law Enforcers some six inches to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the day yimao, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the tenth month Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，客星芒氣長二尺余，西南指，色苍白，在牽牛六度。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renshen, a guest star’s rayed aura was over two feet long, pointed southwest, color pale white, at six degrees of the Herdboy.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the twelfth month a guest star showed a pale coma more than two feet long, thrusting southwest at the sixth degree of Herdboy.

sentences.zh: 客星芒氣白爲兵。

translations.literal: A guest star’s rayed aura white means troops.
translations.idiomatic: A white coma on a guest star augurs war.

sentences.zh: 牽牛爲吳、越。

translations.literal: Herdboy is Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Herdboy governs Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 后一年，會稽海賊曾於等千余人燒句章，殺長吏，又殺鄞、鄮長，取官兵，拘殺吏民，攻東部都尉；

translations.literal: After one year Kuaiji sea bandits Zeng Yu and others over a thousand men burned Gouzhang, killed senior officials, also killed the prefects of Yin and Mao, seized government troops, seized and killed clerks and commoners, and attacked the eastern commandant;
translations.idiomatic: The next year more than a thousand pirates under Zeng Yu of Kuaiji torched Gouzhang, murdered senior magistrates and the heads of Yin and Mao, seized arms, slaughtered officials and civilians, and struck the eastern commandant;

sentences.zh: 扬州六郡逆賊章何等称將軍，犯四十九縣，大攻略吏民。

translations.literal: rebel bandits of six Yangzhou commanderies such as Zhang He and others called themselves generals, offending forty-nine counties, greatly raiding clerks and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: while rebels across six Yangzhou commanderies led by Zhang He styled themselves generals, overran forty-nine counties, and plundered the population wholesale.

sentences.zh: 陽嘉元年閏月戊子，客星氣白，廣二尺，長五丈，起天菀西南。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yangjia, in the intercalary month, on the day wuzi, guest-star vapor white, two feet wide, five rods long, rose from the southwest of the Celestial Park.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the intercalary month of Yangjia 1, a white band two feet broad and five zhang long lifted from the southwest edge of the Celestial Park.

sentences.zh: 主馬牛，爲外軍，色白爲兵。

translations.literal: It governs horses and cattle, is outer troops; color white means troops.
translations.idiomatic: That sector governs horses and cattle and foreign armies; white vapor means mobilization.

sentences.zh: 是時，敦煌太守徐白使疏勒王盘等兵二万人入于窴界，虏掠斬首三百余级。

translations.literal: At this time Dunhuang governor Xu Bai sent King Pan of Shule and others with twenty thousand troops into the border of Yutian, plundering and beheading over three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Dunhuang governor Xu Bai then ordered King Pan of Shule to lead twenty thousand men across the Yutian frontier, where they raided and took more than three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 烏桓校尉耿晔使烏桓親漢都尉戎末瘣等出塞，抄鮮卑，斬首，獲生口、财物；

translations.literal: Wuhuan commandant Geng Ye sent Wuhuan Pro-Han commandant Rong Mo Hui and others beyond the passes to raid the Xianbei, beheading them and capturing people and goods;
translations.idiomatic: Wuhuan commandant Geng Ye sent the Pro-Han Wuhuan colonel Rong Mo Hui outside the wall to strike the Xianbei, taking heads and booty;

sentences.zh: 鮮卑怨恨，抄遼東、代郡，殺傷吏民。

translations.literal: the Xianbei nursed resentment and raided Liaodong and Dai commandery, killing and wounding clerks and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: the Xianbei retaliated by sweeping Liaodong and Dai, killing and maiming officials and townsfolk.

sentences.zh: 是后，西戎、北狄爲寇害，以馬、牛起兵，馬、牛亦死傷于兵中，至十余年乃息。

translations.literal: After this western Rong and northern Di were scourges, raising troops with horses and cattle; horses and cattle also died and were wounded in the troops; only after more than ten years did it subside.
translations.idiomatic: Western tribes and northern nomads then harried the frontiers for a decade, wars flared on horseback, and countless horses and cattle perished in those campaigns before calm returned.

sentences.zh: 永和二年五月戊申，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yonghe, in the fifth month, on the day wushen, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the fifth month of Yonghe 2, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengzi, Mars offended the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the eighth month Mars trespassed on the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 斗爲吳。

translations.literal: The Dipper is Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper here marks the Wu region.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，吳郡太守行丞事羊珍與越兵弟叶、吏民吳铜等二百余人起兵反，殺吏民，燒官亭民舍，攻太守府。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the next year, Wu commandery administrator acting as assistant Yang Zhen with Yue soldier younger brother Ye, clerk-minister Wu Tong, over two hundred men, raised troops in revolt, killed clerks and commoners, burned official lodges and private houses, and attacked the governor’s compound.
translations.idiomatic: The following fifth month Yang Zhen of Wu commandery, acting as chief clerk, with the Yue soldier Ye the younger, Wu Tong the clerk, and more than two hundred followers mutinied, murdered people, torched public buildings and homes, and stormed the governor’s yamen.

sentences.zh: 太守王衡距守，吏兵格殺珍等。

translations.literal: Governor Wang Heng held the defense; clerks and soldiers struck down Zhen and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Wang Heng held the city until his troops cut down the rebels.

sentences.zh: 又九江賊蔡伯流等數百人攻廣陵、九江，燒城郭，殺江都長。

translations.literal: Also Jiujiang bandits Cai Boliu and others several hundred men attacked Guangling and Jiujiang, burned city walls, and killed the chief of Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile hundreds of Jiujiang raiders under Cai Boliu struck Guangling and Jiujiang, fired the walls, and slew the magistrate of Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 三年二月辛巳，太白昼見，戊子，在熒惑西南，光芒相犯。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the second month, on the day xinsi, Great White was seen by day; on the day wuzi it was southwest of Mars, their lights mutually encroaching.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the second month of Yonghe 3 Venus appeared by day; by wuzi it stood southwest of Mars, their glare overlapping.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，有流星大如斗，從西北東行，長八九尺，色赤黄，有聲隆隆如雷。

translations.literal: On xinchou there was a meteor as large as the Dipper, traveling east from the northwest, eight or nine feet long, color red-yellow, with a sound rumbling like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a Dipper-sized meteor streaked from the northwest toward the east, eight or nine feet of red-yellow fire with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renzi, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the third month Venus was visible in daylight again.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingwu, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the sixth month daylight Venus returned.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yimao, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the eighth month Venus once more shone through the day sky.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，辰星入輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiayin, the Morning Star entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiayin, Mercury entered the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Mars entered the Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Mars crossed into the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白昼見。

translations.literal: On yimao, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 太白者，將軍之官，又爲西州。

translations.literal: Great White is the office of the general, also stands for the western provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Venus governs the office of the commander-in-chief and the western quarter of the realm.

sentences.zh: 昼見，陰盛，與君爭明。

translations.literal: Seen by day means yin is flourishing, contending brightness with the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight apparition means yin force has swollen until it rivals the sovereign’s light.

sentences.zh: 熒惑與太白相犯，爲兵喪。

translations.literal: Mars and Great White mutually offending means troops and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars and Venus cross, expect war and bereavement.

sentences.zh: 流星爲使，聲隆隆，怒之象也。

translations.literal: A meteor is an envoy; sound rumbling is the image of wrath.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor is Heaven’s courier; its thunderous roar is an image of divine anger.

sentences.zh: 辰星入輿鬼，爲大臣有死者。

translations.literal: The Morning Star entering the Ghosts means among great ministers there will be deaths.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury in the Ghosts foretells the death of a senior minister.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入太微，乱臣在廷中。

translations.literal: Mars entering the Grand Tenuity means rebellious ministers are in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Mars inside the Grand Tenuity marks traitorous ministers at the emperor’s elbow.

sentences.zh: 是時，大將軍梁商父子秉勢，故太白常昼見也。

translations.literal: At this time great general Liang Shang and his son held power, therefore Great White was often seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: Because great general Liang Shang and his son then monopolized authority, Venus repeatedly blazed in the noon sky.

sentences.zh: 其四年正月，祀南郊，夕牲，中常侍張逵、蘧政、杨定，内者令石光、尚方令傅福等與中常侍曹腾、孟贲爭权，白帝言腾、贲與商謀反，矫詔命收腾、贲，贲自解说，順帝寤，解腾、贲缚。

translations.literal: In that fourth year’s first month, when sacrificing at the southern suburb and inspecting the victim at evening, Regular Attendants Zhang Kui, Qu Zheng, and Yang Ding, Director of the Palace Staff Shi Guang, Director of the Imperial Workshops Fu Fu and others together with Regular Attendants Cao Teng and Meng Ben struggled for power, reported to the emperor that Teng and Ben plotted rebellion with Shang, forged an edict ordering the arrest of Teng and Ben; Ben explained himself, the Shun Emperor awoke to the truth, and released the bonds of Teng and Ben.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of that fourth year, during the southern-suburb sacrifice when the victim was presented at dusk, eunuchs Zhang Kui, Qu Zheng, Yang Ding, palace director Shi Guang, and workshop director Fu Fu vied for influence with Cao Teng and Meng Ben; they accused Teng and Ben of conspiring with Liang Shang, forged an arrest warrant, but Meng Ben cleared himself, the emperor saw through the plot, and freed both men.

sentences.zh: 逵等自知事不從，各奔走，或自刺，解貂蝉投草中逃亡，皆得免。

translations.literal: Kui and the rest each knew the affair would not succeed, each fled, some stabbed themselves, removed cicada-gold hat insignia and cast them in the grass to escape, all obtained exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kui’s party, seeing the coup collapse, scattered in flight; some stabbed themselves, others stripped their court caps and hid in the brush—yet most escaped punishment.

sentences.zh: 其六年，征西將軍馬贤擊西羌于北地射姑山下，父子爲羌所没殺，是其應也。

translations.literal: In that sixth year, General Who Conquers the West Ma Xian struck the Western Qiang below Mount Shegu in Beidi; father and son were drowned and killed by the Qiang; this was its correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Ma Xian, general who conquers the west, fought the Western Qiang at Shegu Mountain in Beidi; he and his son were overwhelmed and slain by the tribesmen—the terrestrial echo of those omens.

sentences.zh: 四年七月壬午，熒惑入南斗犯第三星。

translations.literal: In the fourth Yonghe year, in the seventh month, on the day renwu, Mars entered the Southern Dipper and offended the third star.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the seventh month of the fourth Yonghe year Mars entered the Dipper and struck its third star.

sentences.zh: 五年四月戊午，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the fifth Yonghe year, in the fourth month, on the day wuwu, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the fourth month of the fifth Yonghe year Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiyou, Mars entered the Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eighth month Mars re-entered the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 斗爲貴相，爲扬州，熒惑犯入之爲兵喪。

translations.literal: The Dipper is the eminent minister, is Yangzhou; Mars offending and entering it means troops and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper stands for the chief minister and the Yangzhou region; Mars trespassing there augurs campaigns and loss.

sentences.zh: 其六年，大將軍商薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth Yonghe year, great general Shang passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth Yonghe year great general Liang Shang died.

sentences.zh: 九江、丹陽賊周生、馬勉等起兵攻没郡縣。

translations.literal: Bandits of Jiujiang and Danyang Zhou Sheng, Ma Mian, and others raised troops, attacked, and overthrew commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels Zhou Sheng and Ma Mian of Jiujiang and Danyang then rose, stormed towns, and overran the countryside.

sentences.zh: 梁氏又专权于天廷中。

translations.literal: The Liang clan again monopolized power in Heaven’s court.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang family continued to dominate the celestial court as they did the earthly one.

sentences.zh: 漢安二年正月己亥，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the second year of Han’an, in the first month, on the day jihai, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the first month of Han’an 2, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，辰星犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dinghai, the Morning Star offended the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the fifth month Mercury crossed the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，熒惑光芒犯鎮星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yichou, Mars’s rays offended Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the sixth month the glare of Mars brushed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，太白昼見。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day jiashen, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the seventh month Venus was again visible by day.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯輿鬼爲大喪。

translations.literal: The Morning Star offending the Ghosts means great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury afflicting the Ghosts presages a state bereavement.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯鎮星爲大人忌。

translations.literal: Mars offending Saturn means taboo for great men.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossing Saturn is an omen dreaded by those at the summit of power.

sentences.zh: 明年八月，孝順帝崩，孝冲明年正月又崩。

translations.literal: The next eighth month Emperor Shun the Filial and Harmonious passed away; Emperor Chong the next first month again passed away.
translations.idiomatic: The following eighth month Emperor Shun died; early in the new year his infant successor Chong followed him to the grave.

sentences.zh: 孝質本初元年三月癸丑，熒惑入輿鬼；

translations.literal: In the first year of Benchu of Emperor Zhi the Filial, in the third month, on the day guichou, Mars entered the Ghosts;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the third month of Benchu 1 of Emperor Zhi Mars entered the Ghosts;

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，太白入輿鬼，皆爲大喪。

translations.literal: in the fourth month, on the day xinsi, Great White entered the Ghosts; both mean great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: in the fourth month, on xinsi, Venus entered the Ghosts as well—twin signs of a great funeral.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，太白犯熒惑，爲逆謀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, Great White offended Mars, meaning rebellious plotting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the fifth month Venus crossed Mars, auguring treasonous design.

sentences.zh: 閏月一日，孝質帝爲梁冀所鴆，崩。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary month, Emperor Zhi the Filial was poisoned by Liang Ji and passed away.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary month Liang Ji poisoned Emperor Zhi, and the boy emperor died.
